title: Mutant TP53 promotes invasion of lung cancer cells by regulating desmoglein 3.
authors: Feng, Yu; Qian, Rulin; Cui, Dong; Luan, Jiaqiang; Xu, Mingxing; Wang, Ling; Li, Ruijie; Wu, Xiao; Chang, Chaoying
journal: Journal of cancer research and clinical oncology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究突变TP53通过HIF1-alpha调控DSG3促进肺癌侵袭，虽涉及TP53-DNA结合（ChIP-qPCR）和分子对接，但核心是肿瘤表型而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法以湿实验为主，AI/物理模拟仅辅助。
abstract: PURPOSE: Targeted therapies have markedly improved the prognosis of lung cancer patients; nevertheless, challenges persist, including limited beneficiary populations and the emergence of drug resistance. This study investigates the molecular mechanisms of mutant TP53 in lung cancer, aiming to contribute to novel strategies for targeted therapy. METHODS: The TCGA database was employed to delineate the mutational landscape of TP53 in lung cancer patients. Differential gene expression between TP53-mutant and wild-type patients was analyzed, followed by functional enrichment. DSG3 protein expression in lung cancer patients was assessed using IHC, and its impact on prognosis was analyzed in the TCGA database. The influence of TP53 on the downstream gene DSG3 was investigated using qPCR, ChIP-qPCR, and luciferase reporter gene assays. Protein enrichment in the DSG3 promoter region was examined through IP-MS, and the regulatory role of the HIF1-alpha/TP53 complex on DSG3 was explored using Co-IP, luciferase assays, and ChIP-qPCR. Molecular interactions between TP53 (R273H) and HIF1-alpha were detected through immunoprecipitation and molecular docking. The effects and mechanisms of DSG3 on lung cancer phenotypes were assessed through WB, transwell, and wound healing assays. RESULTS: TP53 mutations were present in 47.44% of patients, predominantly as missense mutations. DSG3 exhibited high expression in TP53-mutant lung cancer patients, and this elevated expression correlated with a poorer prognosis. TP53 interference led to a reduction in DSG3 mRNA expression, with TP53 mutant P53 enriching at the P2 site of the DSG3 promoter region, a recruitment facilitated by HIF1-alpha. The DBD region of TP53 (R273H) demonstrated interaction with HIF1-alpha. DSG3, activated through Ezrin phosphorylation, played a role in promoting invasion and metastasis. CONCLUSIONS: Mutant TP53 facilitates lung cancer cell invasion by modulating desmoglein 3.
abstract_zh: 目的：靶向治疗显著改善了肺癌患者的预后，但仍存在获益人群有限和耐药性出现等挑战。本研究探讨突变型TP53在肺癌中的分子机制，旨在为靶向治疗的新策略提供贡献。方法：利用TCGA数据库描绘肺癌患者中TP53的突变图谱。分析TP53突变型与野生型患者之间的差异基因表达，并进行功能富集分析。通过免疫组化（IHC）评估肺癌患者中DSG3蛋白表达，并在TCGA数据库中分析其对预后的影响。采用qPCR、ChIP-qPCR和荧光素酶报告基因实验研究TP53对下游基因DSG3的影响。通过免疫沉淀-质谱（IP-MS）检测DSG3启动子区域的蛋白富集，并利用Co-IP、荧光素酶实验和ChIP-qPCR探讨HIF1-alpha/TP53复合物对DSG3的调控作用。通过免疫沉淀和分子对接检测TP53（R273H）与HIF1-alpha之间的分子相互作用。通过WB、transwell和伤口愈合实验评估DSG3对肺癌表型的影响及机制。结果：47.44%的患者存在TP53突变，主要为错义突变。DSG3在TP53突变型肺癌患者中高表达，且这种高表达与较差的预后相关。TP53干扰导致DSG3 mRNA表达降低，突变型P53富集于DSG3启动子区域的P2位点，这一招募过程由HIF1-alpha促进。TP53（R273H）的DBD区域与HIF1-alpha存在相互作用。DSG3通过Ezrin磷酸化激活，在促进侵袭和转移中发挥作用。结论：突变型TP53通过调控桥粒芯蛋白3促进肺癌细胞侵袭。
